findings.claim: The private module declaration and exactly three synchronous connect expressions are the only edits to the old unix.rs. Reversing those replacements reproduces all 32,095 original bytes.

200ms is a newly bounded connection stage derived from the existing constant. Original read/write per-operation 200ms, three adoption attempts, 50ms retry spacing, request/response bounds, exact identity and drain ACK rules remain byte-identical. No shared 200ms handshake or recovery deadline is claimed.

A newly returned descriptor immediately enters OwnedFd before any fallible fd configuration. Each error exits through owner Drop; successful conversion transfers ownership into UnixStream and restores blocking mode before returning. No raw descriptor escapes, clones or connection worker threads are introduced.

SOCK_CLOEXEC target list and fallback FD_CLOEXEC behavior preserve fixed std creation policy. Apple/DragonFly/FreeBSD/NetBSD SO_NOSIGPIPE is retained; returned UnixStream preserves its std write implementation, including MSG_NOSIGNAL where defined.

Path encoding matches fixed std semantics: reject any NUL and length at least sun_path capacity; zero initialize sockaddr_un, set family, copy bytes, calculate offset+length+nonempty terminator. Empty path and BSD/Darwin zero sun_len follow that exact std source. No new abstract address contract is introduced.

Only EINPROGRESS/EALREADY/EINTR enter bounded poll. Poll interruptions and short returns recompute from the same monotonic deadline. POLLNVAL and SO_ERROR fail; peer_addr is required before accepting connection success, and the caller checks deadline again before returning the blocking stream.

Linux AF_UNIX EAGAIN on a full listener backlog is not treated as an enqueued pending connection. The errno returns immediately to existing caller policy. Original adoption failure cannot grant signal authority; original WouldBlock/TimedOut drain errors remain no-ACK.

Six new test sources exercise owned listener success and flags, refused listener, Linux-only backlog saturation, expired-before-connect, pathname validation, and poll on a full owned socket. No ignore, assertion relaxation, product child spawning, process environment mutation or existing test replacement. Their runtime outcomes remain NOT_RUN.

Original unix_tests.rs, unix_drain_tests.rs and full paired_process_product.rs retain exact original identities. New files are covered by original Bazel src/**/*.rs glob; dependencies, manifests and locks unchanged. Parent module remains cfg(unix), so no Windows API surface is introduced.

Independent Git index forward/check and reverse/check operations restore full base c3e9 and candidate44e8 exactly. Independent Merkle calculation and all 53 actual root entries agree. 10,801 original leaves are unchanged; one old leaf modified and two added.

Old job127755476318 on source4a has two complete exact trace segments ending after ten_children_ready and before ten_children_adopted. PIDs/snapshot, drop(old), new driver and recover lie in the uninstrumented interval. The stage Instant begins after PairFleet::new; subtracting stage time from nextest60s would misattribute initialization. These records do not prove connect caused either timeout.
